Context: 4. Deputation (Duty) Allowance

The basic pay from time to time after pay fixation should not exceed the maximum of the pay in the level of the ex cadre post.  
- (ii) In Foreign Service I Reverse Foreign Service
- the post in the parent post are based on the same index level and the DA pattern is also same, the pay may be fixed
- (a) When the Level (in Pay Matrix)/ Pay Scale of cadre and that attached to ex cadre as under (i) above.
